'''Spotted Rakerbeast''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A rakerbeast that grew up in the wilderness. These apex predators are endemic to Talos-II. They can leap great distances and attack their prey with razor sharp claws.}}

==Overview==
An extremely agile wildlife creature, the Spotted Rakerbeast is a significant foe due to its extremely high mobility in attacks, making it difficult to damage it:

*Claws once at front, followed by a tail swing that launch spines around, dealing Physical damage.
*Leaps twice, dealing Physical damage on the landing spot, before launching a downwards claw followed by a tail swing around, dealing Physical damage.
*Leaps forward before launching two claws at once, dealing Physical damage.
*Claws twice in quick succession, followed by an upwards claw after a short charge up, dealing Physical damage. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Roars and deals continuous Physical damage before entering '''Enraged State''', which gives it ATK and following ability:
**Leaps forward and deals Physical damage to Operators at front, before lifting its limbs and deals Physical damage ahead after charging up. This ability can be interrupted by skills.

In Area Defense, it gains an extra ability:
*Gain stealth and becomes unable to be targeted by [[Facility/Combat & Support|combat facilities]] when there are enemies nearby. <!--need confirmation-->
